1.plot: After decades without a championship, a new owner and an up-and-coming GM set out to return the Red Sox to glory. But reversing the curse won't be easy.

1.title: EN - The Comeback: 2004 Boston Red Sox [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Part II
1.plot: Injuries and a failed trade for a powerhouse shortstop lead to a rocky 2004 season. But the momentum begins to shift during a series against the Yankees.

1.title: EN - The Comeback: 2004 Boston Red Sox [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Part III
1.plot: Down 3-0 to the Yankees in the ALCS, the Sox launch an epic comeback. A steal, an unwavering pitcher and a Papi homer pave the way to the World Series.

meta.plot: Join animal pals Kiki, Dewey, Hazzy, Luly and Teshi as they learn how to make friends, try new foods and face other big firsts in colorful Roo City!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - First Potty Accident
1.plot: It's Hazzy's turn to lead the pajama parade, but he needs to go to the potty. What should he do to avoid an accident? Stop — and listen to his body!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - First Time Making New Friends
1.plot: Kiki is new to Roo City and wants to meet friends at the playground. She feels shy at first — but soon discovers that saying hello is a great start!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - First Morning Routine
1.plot: Luly wants to dance before nature class, but skipping her morning checklist will make her late. She learns that a routine keeps everything on track!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - First Time I Couldn't Fall Asleep
1.plot: The Groovin' Roos concert is tomorrow, and Dewey is too excited to sleep! But if he doesn't calm down, he'll be too tired to enjoy the show.

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - First Glasses
1.plot: Teshi's first trip to the eye doctor is full of new experiences. But asking questions and paying attention during the visit makes him feel less scared.

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - First Sunburn
1.plot: It's pool party time, and Kiki's ready for some fun in the sun. But when she decides to skip out on the sunscreen, she gets a painful sunburn. Ouch!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - First Snowy Day
1.plot: It's snowing in Roo City, and Dewey wants to play outside with his pals! But will he take the time to put on warm winter clothes to stay safe and cozy?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - First Time Trying a New Food
1.plot: Hazzy's unsure about tasting a pickle for the first time. But with Teshi and Luly cheering him on, he might just discover a yummy new snack!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - First Time Losing Something Special
1.plot: When Teshi can't find his favorite stuffed animal, he learns to handle the feelings of losing something important to him with the support of his friends.

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - First Compromise
1.plot: Luly and Kiki are baking cookies for their friends but can't agree on a surprise ingredient. Can they come up with a solution that makes them both happy?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - First Apology
1.plot: Kiki covers Teshi's puppet, Little T, with bubbles at Hazzy's car wash, which makes Teshi upset. Can Kiki fix things up with an apology?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - First Time Getting a Shot
1.plot: Hazzy's worried about getting his first shot at the doctor. Will sharing his feelings with the other Wonderoos help him feel better?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - First Time I Had to Be Calm
1.plot: Dewey's excited to see dinosaur bones and other exhibits at the museum. But he has to learn how to calm down before visiting a special room about space.

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - First Time Talking About Differences
1.plot: Hazzy's painting a picture of the Wonderoos! When Luly notices that Hazzy missed one of her special features, will she say something — or keep it inside?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - First Long Wait
1.plot: There's a long line for the magic show, and Teshi doesn't want to wait! Will he skip the show or enjoy the time with his pals?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - First Time Getting Lost
1.plot: Hazzy wanders away from Luly to play a game at the carnival, then realizes he's lost. It's always best to stick with a buddy — and now he knows!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - First Time at the Dentist
1.plot: Kiki has her very first dentist visit, then goes home for a fun sleepover with friends. But will she do the right thing and brush her teeth before bed?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - First Time I Didn't Want to Tell the Truth
1.plot: As the Wonderoos set up a surprise birthday party for Hazzy, Dewey sneaks a bite of the cake. Will he tell the truth when his friends ask what happened?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - First Time Playing On My Own
1.plot: It's raining outside, so Hazzy wants to have some fun indoors! But since the other Wonderoos are busy, he'll have to learn to play on his own.

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - First Time I Had to Put My Screen Away
1.plot: While Teshi is busy with his new tablet, his friends are having a blast at the park: Will he set his screen aside so he can play with them?

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - First Pet
2.plot: Kiki's excited to get a pet, but furry little Fifi hides from her. When Kiki learns that it's best to be calm and gentle with pets, Fifi's ready to play!

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - First Big Mess
2.plot: While making parade decorations, Luly and Teshi make a big mess. Teshi doesn't want to miss the fun, but should he leave Luly to clean it up alone?

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - First Big Roo Bed
2.plot: Hazzy misses his baby bed until Luly shows him how to make his new bigger bed feel cozy. Now he's happy to have more room to cuddle with lots of stuffies!

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - First Haircut
2.plot: Dewey's long hair gets in the way of playing, and he's afraid to get it trimmed. But asking questions makes him brave — and the haircut doesn't hurt!

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - First Library Book
2.plot: When Kiki sees a pretty picture in a library book, she really wants it! Should she tear it out or take care of the book so others can enjoy it?

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - First Train Ride
2.plot: Luly wants to join the gang for a trip to Poppy Park, but she's never been on a train before. With her friends by her side, it's fun to try new things!

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - First Time Sharing
2.plot: While Teshi's playing with all the blocks, Hazzy asks if he can use some of them, too. Should Teshi share — or should Hazzy go play with something else?

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - First Time Feeling Mad
2.plot: When Kiki drops the cookies she made, her day gets worse! Her pals show her how to make big, mad feelings go away — then share some yummy broken cookies!

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - First Time Feeling Scared
2.plot: Boom! Loud, scary sounds make Hazzy hide in his room. But when his friends help him understand what's making the noise, he isn't afraid anymore!

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - First Time Feeling Jealous
2.plot: On Switcheroo Day, Dewey wears Kiki's glasses and loves them so much that it makes him feel jealous. What can he do to feel better?

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - First Big Goodbye
2.plot: Luly's sad that Kiki's going on a trip because she'll miss her! But Luly's happy when she learns how to keep in touch with Kiki until she comes home.

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - First Time Taking Things Slow
2.plot: Kiki can't wait to build her first toy boat! Her pals follow the instructions, go slow and think it through... but Kiki's boat sinks. What went wrong?

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E13 - First Time Losing a Game
2.plot: After Dewey invents a new game, he loses and gets frustrated. Should he quit because he isn't winning or keep playing just for fun?

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E14 - First Time Learning Personal Space
2.plot: Mind the Roo bubble! Hazzy steps into Teshi's personal space with a hug, but Teshi doesn't like it. Should Hazzy have asked permission first?

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E15 - First Time a Friend Looked Sad
2.plot: Everyone has fun on Silly Hat Day... but Dewey's hat is broken, and he's sad. Should Luly ask him if he's OK or keep playing with her pals?

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E16 - First Time I Kept Trying
2.plot: Teshi has a tough time learning how to ride a pedal boat. If he gives up, he'll miss out on the fun — but if he keeps trying, he might get better at it!

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E17 - The First Time a Pet Died
2.plot: When a friend's pet dies, Kiki struggles with her feelings. But the Wonderoos soon realize that sometimes sadness comes with a mix of happy memories.

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E18 - First New Baby
2.plot: Hazzy is jealous when baby Hudzy gets all the attention. But he discovers taking care of little Roos is very important — especially when they're fussy!

2.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB] - S02E19 - First Big Trip (1) / First Big Trip (2)
2.plot: The Wonderoos are excited — and a little nervous — about their big trip. But sharing new things they've learned helps them relax and have a good time!

meta.plot: A six-way partner-swap sparks wild attractions and tearful betrayals. Participants choose whom to love and leave in this heart-pounding experiment.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: South Africa [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Split
1.plot: Emotions run high as couples prepare for a transformative journey exploring new romantic partners — and potentials.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: South Africa [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Choice
1.plot: At a cocktail party, the couples make critical choices, setting the stage for deeper connections and more emotional revelations.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: South Africa [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - New Bed, New Partner
1.plot: A trial marriage forces the couples to consider whether to stay loyal to their original partner or test the waters with a new love interest.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: South Africa [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Jealousy and Suspicion
1.plot: Some of the couples find difficulty letting go of their past, which strains their new arrangements.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: South Africa [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Revelations and Reveals
1.plot: When family members weigh in, couples face tough truths. A surprise twist at a group gathering sends shockwaves, testing every union.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: South Africa [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Broken Bonds and Boundaries
1.plot: As the experiment draws to a close, heartfelt moments contrast with tense confrontations, leaving several couples with tough choices to make.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: South Africa [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Back to Reality
1.plot: Reunited with their original partners, couples sift through their experiences and consider their futures together.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: South Africa [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Last Dance
1.plot: Time is almost up for the couples, whose reflections on the nature of love and commitment raise questions about their relationships' viability.

meta.plot: Starting from nothing, 13 players compete for a spot in a luxury villa and a shot at 150,000 euros in this unpredictable game of strategy and survival.

1.title: EN - Don't Hate the Player [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Welcome to Hell
1.plot: Thirteen confused contestants arrive at the camp. Rules are explained, clans are formed and a captain is elected ahead of a brutal battle of the boxes.

1.title: EN - Don't Hate the Player [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Clan vs. Clan
1.plot: After a tense beach standoff, the chosen ones make their way to the villa and plan for their first assembly. Jordan takes his destiny into his own hands.

1.title: EN - Don't Hate the Player [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Duel Is On
1.plot: A contender is chosen and the duel begins. In a bid to avoid elimination and win a spot at the villa, two players face off in a test of mettle and nerve.

1.title: EN - Don't Hate the Player [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - New Players, New Headaches
1.plot: The camp members greet a surprise arrival with suspicion and fatigue. Faced with a high-stakes decision, an emotional Emia is at odds with her friends.

1.title: EN - Don't Hate the Player [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - A Promise Is a Promise
1.plot: The previous night's decision causes upset in the camp. As a new relationship blossoms in the villa, a confident camp member promotes his perfect plan.

1.title: EN - Don't Hate the Player [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Clean Sweep
1.plot: Two players go head-to-head in a daring duel with double the stakes. A wily contestant attempts to break up the core group. The boxes of destiny return.

1.title: EN - Don't Hate the Player [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Every Man for Himself...
1.plot: Promises are broken on the beach. A member of the villa is given special powers ahead of the third duel. Hugo and Thibault try to sway the same player.

1.title: EN - Don't Hate the Player [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - ...And God for All
1.plot: At the assembly, the fate of one player rebounds dramatically. With only two opportunities left to rise to the villa, camp members prepare for battle.

1.title: EN - Don't Hate the Player [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Grand Finale
1.plot: Backstabbing and blocking decide the fate of some. In the final, members of the camp play a decisive role. Can trust triumph or will greed win the game?

meta.plot: Le 21 décembre 1988, le vol Pan Am 103 explose au-dessus de la petite ville écossaise de Lockerbie, faisant 270 morts. S'ensuit la plus vaste enquête criminelle de l'histoire de la police écossaise, sur l'attentat terroriste le plus meurtrier jamais commis sur le sol britannique. À travers les témoignages de ceux qui l'ont vécu, voici l'histoire vraie de la collaboration entre la police écossaise et les forces de l'ordre américaines, et du combat des familles pour obtenir justice.

1.title: FR - L'Attentat du vol Pan Am 103 - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: 21 December 1988. A bomb detonates on board Pan Am flight 103 above Lockerbie. The attack kills 270 people. The Scottish police and FBI must join forces to find the perpetrators.

1.title: FR - L'Attentat du vol Pan Am 103 - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: In the weeks following the bombing, the pressure to make progress is immense. The joint Scottish-FBI investigation closes in on its first suspect.

1.title: FR - L'Attentat du vol Pan Am 103 - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The Scottish police head to the US with new evidence and a potential breakthrough. But the CIA appears to be withholding crucial intelligence on a possible bomb-maker.

1.title: FR - L'Attentat du vol Pan Am 103 - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The Frankfurt luggage list and bomb-damaged clothing leads Scottish CID to a small clothes shop on the island of Malta. Was this the origin of the bomb?

1.title: FR - L'Attentat du vol Pan Am 103 - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: While the joint Scottish and FBI investigation closes in on the identity of the 'mystery shopper', a CIA asset could hold the key to the identity of the Pan Am 103 bombers.

1.title: FR - L'Attentat du vol Pan Am 103 - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Over a decade after the Lockerbie bombing, following much debate and international negotiation, the accused finally stand trial.

meta.plot: Au travers de récits de témoins directs et de personnalités du monde entier, cette série documentaire analyse en détail les tenants et aboutissants de la guerre froide.

1.title: FR - Turning Point : L'arme nucléaire et la guerre froide - S01E01 - The Sun Came Up Tremendous
1.plot: During World War II, the US begins to work on a top-secret project that results in the atomic bombings on Japan — and a global conflict lasting decades.

1.title: FR - Turning Point : L'arme nucléaire et la guerre froide - S01E02 - Poisoning the Soil
1.plot: As communism takes off in Russia and China, Joseph Stalin begins his ruthless reign and the Soviet Union enters an era of terror.

1.title: FR - Turning Point : L'arme nucléaire et la guerre froide - S01E03 - Institutional Insanity
1.plot: Preparing for war against the Soviet Union, the US starts to test thermonuclear weapons. The CIA forms and interferes with global politics.

1.title: FR - Turning Point : L'arme nucléaire et la guerre froide - S01E04 - The Wall
1.plot: The US and Soviet Union get caught in a nuclear arms race. A wall divides Berlin. John F. Kennedy looks for a peaceful solution after a crisis in Cuba.

1.title: FR - Turning Point : L'arme nucléaire et la guerre froide - S01E05 - War Games
1.plot: With both sides planning for the worst-case scenario, Ronald Reagan and Mikhail Gorbachev find common ground. Tragedy strikes after a nuclear disaster.

1.title: FR - Turning Point : L'arme nucléaire et la guerre froide - S01E06 - Empire Is Untenable
1.plot: The USSR's grasp on Eastern Europe weakens as the Berlin Wall comes down and the Communist Party mounts a coup against a prominent Soviet Union leader.

1.title: FR - Turning Point : L'arme nucléaire et la guerre froide - S01E07 - The End of History
1.plot: A new Russian leader emerges, and the republics seek independence. As the Soviet Union dissolves, several powers sign a landmark treaty on nuclear arms.

1.title: FR - Turning Point : L'arme nucléaire et la guerre froide - S01E08 - Moscow Will Not Be Silent
1.plot: Russia struggles to find a national identity as Vladimir Putin comes to power. With the Cold War in the rearview, a war on terror begins.

1.title: FR - Turning Point : L'arme nucléaire et la guerre froide - S01E09 - We Are Not Dead Yet
1.plot: Russia invades Georgia and Ukraine, putting Putin under intense scrutiny. While disinformation thrives, threats of nuclear war persist.

1.title: FR - The Rapture [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After a life-altering car accident, clinical psychologist Dr Gabs Fox meets Bethany Krall, a teenager accused of brutally murdering her mother. But Bethany insists she is innocent.

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire se penche sur une affaire de meurtre impliquant un chef espagnol dont la carrière repose sur un tissu de secrets et de fausses identités.

1.title: FR - Recette sordide : L'escroc devenu meurtrier - S01E01 - Like a King
1.plot: In August 2018, police find a human torso in a suitcase. The case soon leads to César Román, an eccentric entrepreneur known as the "King of Cachopo."

1.title: FR - Recette sordide : L'escroc devenu meurtrier - S01E02 - The King's Speech
1.plot: As witnesses agree how Heydi changed upon meeting César, he gives his version of her final night. Details of his escape come out.

1.title: FR - Recette sordide : L'escroc devenu meurtrier - S01E03 - The Dethroned King
1.plot: After two and a half years, the trial begins. César acts as his own lawyer, ready to highlight some gaps in the investigation and prove his innocence.

meta.plot: 1987. Au plus fort de la contestation démocratique contre le pouvoir dictatorial en Corée du Sud, un jeune étudiant, Im Soo-Ho, fait irruption dans le dortoir d'une université féminine, couvert de sang. Il y rencontre Eun Young-Cho, une brillante étudiante en littérature anglaise avec laquelle il va développer une relation amoureuse, au milieu des tumultes politiques et de la répression du régime...

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Yeong-ro, a fresh and lively freshman at Hosu Women's University, falls in love at first sight with Soo-ho at a group blind date.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Soo-ho comes into the window of Room 207 in Women's University Dormitory and collapses. Young-ro and others try to hide him from the officers.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Youngro takes care of the injured Soo-ho and tries to find a way to send him out from the dormitory.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Soo-ho, who leaves the dormitory, begins to secretly move again. Meanwhile, Lee Kang-moo secures decisive evidence of Soo-ho's whereabouts and pursues him.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Soo-ho negotiates with the head of the National Security Agency to escape the dormitory with his teammates.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Turning a blind eye to Yeong-ro who feels betrayed, Soo-ho continues the hostage crisis, and a doctor, Kang Chung-ya, is sent in to treat an injured associate of Soo-ho.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: When Soo-ho realises Yeong-ro is the daughter of the head of the National Security Agency, he has no choice but to use Yeong-ro to make it out alive.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Soo-ho's heart breaks because of Yeong-ro. Meanwhile, the tension builds up as the hostage crisis makes it to the news nationwide.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Yeong-ro does not believe in Soo-ho's sincerity and eventually works out an escape plan with Gang-mu.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: When the anonymous reveals their identity, Han-na carries out Gang-mu's order and moves to catch the secret evidence surrounding the hostage crisis.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Finally facing the cruel truth surrounding the hostage crisis, Soo-ho joins hands with his enemy Gang-mu and suppresses Cheong-ya.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: With the situation getting worse, Soo-ho and Yeong-ro depend on each other more. Soo-ho and Kang-moo expose the scheme behind the presidential election.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: Soo-ho comforts Yeong-ro who no longer trusts her father. Students are confused as to which side they should trust.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: Soo-ho is heartbroken to see Yeong-ro struggling with guilt after hearing the news about her father. Soo-ho and Kang-moo start distrusting each other.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E15 - Episode 15
1.plot: Giving up his hope in Cheong-ya, Soo-ho has no choice but to accept the head of the National Security Agency's proposal.

1.title: FR - Snowdrop - S01E16 - Episode 16
1.plot: Soo-ho, who left Yeong-ro, stands at the crossroads of fate just before returning to his hometown.

meta.plot: Quand de mystérieux événements modifient la trajectoire d'un bateau voguant vers New York en 1899, ses passagers se retrouvent au cœur d'une énigme des plus stupéfiantes.

1.title: FR - 1899 [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - The Ship
1.plot: Maura helps a pregnant woman. The captain makes a brave decision after receiving a message from a lost ship — and discovers something mind-bending.

1.title: FR - 1899 [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - The Boy
1.plot: The captain experiences unexplainable flashbacks. A strange man follows Maura to her cabin where a boy is hiding. A bug leads to a tragedy on deck.

1.title: FR - 1899 [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - The Fog
1.plot: A girl and other passengers suffer a terrible fate. Olek frees Ling Yi from a box. The captain makes a discovery that challenges his trust in Maura.

1.title: FR - 1899 [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - The Fight
1.plot: Several crew members and passengers search the ship for the boy after locking up the captain, Olek, Jérôme and Ramiro. Krester's secret is revealed.

1.title: FR - 1899 [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - The Calling
1.plot: Maura has terrible flashbacks and makes a shocking move. A sound leads some passengers to jump overboard. Maura makes a discovery about her father.

1.title: FR - 1899 [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - The Pyramid
1.plot: Tove has scary flashbacks and wants to kill the boy. Daniel follows Maura and the captain into a strange place. Maura's father appears with a message.

1.title: FR - 1899 [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - The Storm
1.plot: Daniel asks Maura for something she doesn't understand. Olek and Ling Yi steer the ship before a tragedy occurs. Elliot's identity comes to light.

1.title: FR - 1899 [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - The Key
1.plot: Maura tells the passengers an unbelievable truth. Then, their memories shift and Daniel changes a code. Maura faces an unexpected reality.

meta.plot: The sale of Paul and Lydia's picture-perfect LA home forces them to face painful family secrets — and hide them from prying eyes and cutthroat buyers.

1.title: EN - No Good Deed [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Open House
1.plot: Paul and Lydia clash over their future and fend off blackmail threats as they watch potential buyers tour their painstakingly renovated Los Feliz home.

1.title: EN - No Good Deed [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Private Showing
1.plot: As Lydia's second thoughts send Paul scrambling, she shares an emotional moment — and advice — with Sarah. Margo attempts to mix business with pleasure.

1.title: EN - No Good Deed [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Letters of Intent
1.plot: Lydia and Paul disagree on how to handle Mikey. Carla discovers just how close Dennis is to his mom. Leslie and Sarah run up against some harsh truths.

1.title: EN - No Good Deed [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Foundation Issues

meta.plot: What started in 1975 with the disappearance of 20 people from a small town in Oregon, ended in 1997 with the largest suicide on US soil and changed the face of modern New Age religion forever. This four-part docuseries uses never-before-seen footage and first-person accounts to explore the infamous UFO cult that shocked the nation with their out-of-this-world beliefs.

1.title: EN - Heaven's Gate: The Cult of Cults [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Awakening
1.plot: March 1997. Thirty-nine members of the Heaven’s Gate cult are found dead in a Southern California mansion - the largest mass suicide in U.S. history. The inception of this mysterious group dates back to 1970s Oregon, where founding members Bonnie Nettles and Marshall Applewhite begin to recruit individuals interested in end-of-the-world Christianity, new age religion, and UFOs - but the disappearance of new members soon drives media attention and family concerns.

1.title: EN - Heaven's Gate: The Cult of Cults [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Chrysalis

After Ti dies from cancer in 1985, a distraught Do briefly allows members to visit their families, and a few consider leaving the group for good. When the members return, Do becomes much more controlling - and opens the door to group suicide.

1.title: EN - Heaven's Gate: The Cult of Cults [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Second Harvest
1.plot: Using a popular sci-fi TV series to help bolster his teachings, Do encourages asexuality and individual submission for the benefit of the collective - and even initiates voluntary castrations. Having dwindled in number, the group starts recruiting again, but they’re met largely with derision and skepticism. Seeing this as a sign, Do begins planning their exit to the next level.

1.title: EN - Heaven's Gate: The Cult of Cults [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Exit
1.plot: The 1997 arrival of the Hale-Bopp comet spurs the group to prepare for their departure, though their plan to commit mass suicide goes undetected. After an anonymous 911 caller alerts the authorities, Heaven’s Gate, deemed the first "internet cult," becomes a media and pop culture phenomenon - but the suicides have a very different effect on those closest to them. Today, former members, loved ones, and experts reflect on the legacy of Heaven’s Gate, offering a chilling reminder that indoctrination can happen to anyone.
